reason: A better satisfies the full question by specifying an alloy, processing intervention, low-field/temperature regime, baseline, thermal and mechanical measurements, and a falsification test. Its mechanism remains questionable because grain boundaries and annealing-induced strain can increase domain-wall pinning and coercivity—as some cited evidence indicates—but B is less decisive, leaves the minor element and composition undefined, treats a few tesla as low field, and does not directly test heat exchange.
